parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.slotId: The stable identity used to match this chrome slot.
parameters.aspect: The width-to-height ratio of the content.
parameters.label: The visible or accessible name of this part.
parameters.fit: How the image fits inside its frame.
parameters.width: Sets the width of the media frame.
parameters.bare: Draws the image without its usual frame.
